label: Katana
description: Send Swell orders to Katana as sales orders, and every 5 minutes bring status, tracking and stock changes back to Swell. Create an API key in Katana → Settings → API → API keys. Jobs are listed under Katana tasks and checks under Katana pulls in the dashboard sidebar.

actions.label: Test connection
actions.hint: Checks the API key and lists your Katana locations and tax rates with their IDs. Save settings first.

actions.label: Get updates from Katana
actions.hint: Looks for sales order and stock changes in Katana right away, instead of waiting for the 5-minute check. Checks that change something are logged under Katana pulls.

actions.label: Sync stock from Katana
actions.hint: Starts a job that copies all Katana stock at the location to Swell, page by page. Follow it under Katana tasks in the sidebar.

actions.label: Create products in Katana
actions.hint: Creates Katana products and variants for Swell products with stock tracking on, and sets their starting stock in Katana to the Swell stock. Follow it under Katana tasks.

modal.title: Create products in Katana
modal.description: For every Swell product with stock tracking on, creates the Katana product with its variants (matched by SKU; SKUs already in Katana are not created again). Then, for variants that have no stock in Katana at the location, adds a stock adjustment so Katana stock equals the Swell stock. Items without a SKU are skipped. After this, Katana is the source of truth for stock again.

fields.label: API key
fields.description: Required. Katana → Settings → API → API keys → Add new API key

fields.label: Location ID
fields.description: Required for syncing. Katana location that ships Swell orders and whose stock is copied to Swell. Save the API key, then use Test connection to see the IDs.

fields.label: Tax rate ID
fields.description: Optional. Katana tax rate set on every sales order row and the shipping fee. Leave empty to use Katana's default.

fields.label: Sales order number prefix
fields.description: Katana sales order number is this prefix followed by the Swell order number, e.g. SW-1001

fields.label: When a Swell order is canceled

options.label: Delete the Katana sales order (if not shipped yet)

fields.label: Create Swell shipment when delivered in Katana
fields.description: Fulfills the Swell order with the tracking number from Katana

fields.label: Sync stock from Katana automatically
fields.description: Sets Swell stock levels from Katana by SKU: every 5 minutes for items that moved, plus an hourly stock sync job. Only products with stock tracking on are changed.

fields.label: Sync job page size
fields.description: Katana inventory rows or Swell orders read per step of a Katana sync job (1-250). Each step also stops after about 7 seconds and the next step continues.

fields.label: Sales orders last checked
fields.description: When the last 5-minute check of sales orders finished. The next one reads changes from a minute before.

fields.label: Stock last checked
fields.description: When the last 5-minute check of stock movements finished. The next one reads changes from a minute before.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Turns off all syncing without uninstalling the app
